subject: Exec seat escrow request — Echo Systems pilot demo (VP availability + backup plan)
messages:
From: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@echosys.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: Taylor Chen <taylor.chen@echosys.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Exec intro + demo — can VP join next Tue?

Hi Ben,

We’re excited to move forward with the pilot and wanted to request a short executive intro at the top of the demo next Tuesday, 24 Jun. Our VP of Product (Anna Lopez) would like to attend for the first 20–25 minutes to hear about the deployment guarantees and cost profile.

Two slots that work for us (PT):
- 11:00–11:45 (pref)
- 14:00–14:45 (backup)

Can you confirm whether Redwood can hold an exec seat for the first 25 minutes and provide an internal backup if the VP needs to drop early? If the CIO or CTO might join, we’ll flag that in the calendar but don’t yet have a firm yes.

Also — can you share a short one-page exec brief and the draft SOW ahead of time? We’ll circulate both to our procurement and security teams.

Thanks,
Megan Ruiz
Director, Platform Partnerships
Echo Systems
[Attachment: Echo-Req-Note.txt]

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@echosys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo — can VP join next Tue?

Megan — thanks, this is great. We can absolutely reserve an "exec seat" at the top of the session and have a named backup ready to cover the remainder. Quick notes/asks: 

1) Recommended format: 10–15 minute exec intro (VP), then 30–35 minute demo with tech deep-dive options. If Anna prefers 25 minutes for the exec slot we can adjust, but keeping the demo to 30–35 helps us cover the deployment runs.
2) We’ll propose 11:00–11:45 PT as primary. Please confirm within the day if that remains your preference.
3) Attached: Redwood-Exec-Brief.pdf (one-pager) and a draft SOW (Echo-SOW-draft-2025.docx).

Internal backup plan: Marissa will serve as the executive cover (high-level product & pricing) if anyone needs to drop; Soojin will handle technical continuity and will keep a short slide set for rapid handoff.

I’ll hold the 11:00–11:45 slot tentatively and send a calendar hold that invites Anna and your procurement alias. Once you confirm, I’ll convert to a final invite with dial-in + runbook.

Best,
Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Exec-Brief.pdf]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Cc: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@echosys.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo — can VP join next Tue?

Ben — quick operational ask from my side: can we lock a 10-minute dry run the morning of the demo for exec talking points? I’d like to ensure the VP sees the 1-pager screen-first and that our pricing lead is queued to share the cost slide at the 12-minute mark.

Soojin — can you prep a two-slide handoff summary (stateful model footprint + expected latency/cost for pilot) so Marissa can step in cleanly if the VP leaves after 20–25 minutes?

Megan — if you can confirm Anna’s preferred dial-in (video or just call) I’ll tailor the invite. Also, please let me know if the CIO is merely optional or likely to attend so we can expand the exec intro scope.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Taylor Chen <taylor.chen@echosys.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@echosys.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo — can VP join next Tue?

Ben/Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround. Anna can do 11:00–11:45 PT and would prefer video. CIO (Ravi Patel) is on the fence; he’s asked to be penciled in but will confirm tomorrow. If Ravi attends, we may need a 45-minute slot, otherwise 35-minute demo + 10-minute exec intro is perfect.

We’ll accept the attachments — procurement will start reviewing the SOW but may have redlines. Please send the calendar invite as a tentative hold and we’ll convert to a confirmed invite once we lock Ravi.

Taylor Chen
Sr. PM, Integrations
Echo Systems

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: Megan Ruiz <megan.ruiz@echosys.com>, Taylor Chen <taylor.chen@echosys.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Exec intro + demo — can VP join next Tue?

All — great, thanks for the clarity. Final plan we’ll hold: 11:00–11:45 PT on Tue 24 Jun (video). Agenda attached in the calendar invite: 10–10:05 dry run (Redwood execs only), 11:00–11:10 exec intro (Anna + Ben), 11:10–11:40 demo deep dive, 11:40–11:45 close & next steps.

Action items:
- Megan/Taylor: add Ravi (CIO) to the thread if he confirms; if he does we’ll extend the demo by 15 minutes and share an updated run order.
- Marissa: run the 10:05 dry run and bring the two-slide handoff.
- Soojin: upload the technical 2-slide handoff to the Drive folder and link in the invite.

I’ll post the tentative calendar hold now (https://cal.redwood.com/hold/ben/20250624/1145) and include the one-pager + draft SOW. Looking forward to it.

Ben Carter
Director, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-Exec-Brief.pdf, Echo-SOW-draft-2025.docx]
